verdict.rationale: Founder Law is an attorney-led immigration and startup legal service. An API is a plausible ask in founder legal services, where automated tools compete, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no documented public API: OpenAPI and Swagger probes all returned 404, and the only machine-readable artifact is an llms.txt summary, which is not a programmable interface. The firm also positions itself against automated tools in favor of accountable attorneys.
